D10-00 [SDK-in-browser, diagnostic] a create-only transaction can check a not-yet-existing copy id

D10-02 decline: "Not now" writes nothing to the cloud and leaves originals byte-identical; no repeat prompt for that coach
D10-03 repeat import is idempotent: same IDs, no duplicates, existing copies not rewritten

D10-05 a copy changed elsewhere is never overwritten; import stops without acknowledging
D10-06 two coaches, one browser profile: coach B never sees or reads coach A's imported copies

D10-07 team switch while a copy is in flight: no acknowledgement, nothing written to the new team, stale completion discarded (5 s observation window)
D10-07b [founder rule: no duplicate imports] an import interrupted in team A is not silently re-offered as a fresh import into team B
D10-08 sign-out (the app reloads the page) while a copy is in flight, then a second coach signs in: nothing attributed to that coach
D10-09 [SDK-in-browser] cross-team denial with an authorized positive control
D10-06c [founder rule: no cross-account exposure / duplicates] while coach A's import is unfinished, coach B on the same device is not offered the same plays
D10-06d [founder rule: originals preserved, no dead end] after coach A declines ("Not now") an interrupted import, some account can still act on the device plays
D10-06e [founder rule: R1c recovery] "Not now" postpones an unfinished import; the original coach and team can resume and finish with verified copies; another coach stays blocked; originals untouched
D10-08a [PR #72] status-less claim + matching pending + prior decline: the original coach on the original team is offered the resume and finishes with exact verified copies; originals untouched
D10-08b [PR #72] status-less claim for a DIFFERENT team of the same coach: no resume on this team; nothing copied; originals untouched
D10-08c [PR #72] status-less claim of coach A: another coach B on the same device is blocked, sees why, copies nothing under B; A's claim and originals untouched
D10-08d [PR #72] resume with a mismatching server copy at the deterministic ID: no success, no overwrite, claim stays pending, originals untouched
N2-D0 [diagnostic] baseline lifecycle: server commit vs dialog close, Firestore channel traffic; exactly one team
N2-D1 [diagnostic] write reaches the server but its acknowledgement channel is cut for 8 s: does the dialog stick, recover, or duplicate?
N2-D3 [diagnostic] the write POST reaches the server but its HTTP response is held 8 s: which channel carries the acknowledgement?
N2-D4 [diagnostic] the Write stream back channel is held (not reset) 8 s: is the team saved while the dialog stays on Creating...?
N2-D2 [diagnostic] write held (pending, not on the server): coach cancels, leaves Teams, returns and creates again; how many teams result?
N2-A1 [acceptance] after the Write stream is reset and connectivity restored, the team is saved exactly once, the UI recovers, and an explicit saving/connection status is shown while unconfirmed
N2-A2 [obsolete-fault-model] cancelling or leaving during a pending create and trying again never produces a duplicate team
N2-R1 [acceptance] REST commit held through an 8 s outage (request not yet at the server): accessible status within 8 s; the same operation completes once; server and UI agree
N2-R1b [acceptance] REST commit fails with a connection reset during an 8 s outage: accessible status within 8 s; after restore the same operation completes once; server and UI agree
N2-R1c [acceptance] lost response AFTER server commit (commit delivered, its response dropped): accessible status within 8 s; recovery confirms the same team without a duplicate; server and UI agree
N2-R2 [acceptance] REST create held pending; coach leaves and returns to Teams and tries the same team again: pending stays recoverable; exactly one team (owner, ID, name, code)
N2-R3 [acceptance] pending REST creation survives a page refresh and the same coach recovers it once
N2-R4 [acceptance] account isolation A -> B -> A: B cannot see or resume A's pending team; A recovers it once
N2-R5 [acceptance] commit appears to succeed but the authoritative readback finds nothing: no success is reported; after recovery the same operation is created once at the original ID
N2-R6 [acceptance] a different team already exists at the operation's document ID: no success, no overwrite, no second team, even after Check and retry
N2-R7 [acceptance] intentional same-name team: an explicit confirmation is required; declining creates nothing; confirming creates exactly one separate team
N2-R7b [acceptance] a confirmed same-name creation whose commit is reset is retried as the SAME operation: no third team
N2-R8 [acceptance] authoritative readback fails at the network level (and nothing is on the server): no success; after restore the same operation is created once

N2-R8b [acceptance] SDK listener unavailable, commit reaches the server, authoritative readback returns 503: no false success, no duplicate, no overwrite; the same operation is confirmed once after restore
